description: Held-out golden set for `php artisan rag:eval --set=resources/eval/holdout.json`, in the same format as questions.json and over the same corpus. These questions were written after retrieval was tuned on questions.json and are never used for tuning, so they show whether the settings generalise. Many target the five documents that overlap others on purpose (the auto-empty dock and the vacuum manual, contractor guidelines and the handbook, procurement and expenses, data retention and security, onboarding and the handbook).

cases.question: What is part number BAG-25?
cases.expect: Replacement bags have part number BAG-25

cases.question: What does policy FIN-PRC-2026 cover?
cases.expect: Policy reference: FIN-PRC-2026

cases.question: What is Ledgerly?
cases.expect: the supplier portal, Ledgerly

cases.question: What is Buyline used for?
cases.expect: Purchase orders are raised in Buyline

cases.question: What is Peoplebase?
cases.expect: the HR system, Peoplebase

cases.question: What format does a PO number have?
cases.expect: in the format PO-123456

cases.question: What does E-58 mean on the HX2?
cases.expect: E-58: Bin missing

cases.question: What does E-58 mean on the M1 mower?
cases.expect: E-58: Lifted

cases.question: Who is paged for a SEV2?
cases.expect: the incident commander joins during business hours

cases.question: Which firmware does the HX2 need to work with the Auto-Empty Dock?
cases.expect: firmware version 3.2 or later

cases.question: What is the P3 response time for Business customers?
cases.expect: 2 business days for P3

cases.question: How long does a dust bag in the auto-empty dock last?
cases.expect: holds about 45 days of debris

cases.question: What does a flashing orange light on the dock mean?
cases.expect: the bag is full or missing

cases.question: How loud is the auto-empty dock?
cases.expect: around 78 dB

cases.question: What warranty does the Auto-Empty Dock have?
cases.expect: one-year limited warranty, separate from the vacuum's own warranty

cases.question: When must contractors send their monthly invoice?
cases.expect: by the fifth working day of the following month

cases.question: What notice is needed to end a contractor engagement?
cases.expect: Either side can end an engagement

cases.question: When do contractor accounts expire?
cases.expect: accounts expire automatically on the SOW end date

cases.question: Which purchases need three competing quotes?
cases.expect: three competing quotes and approval from Finance

cases.question: How long does supplier onboarding take?
cases.expect: which takes about 10 working days

cases.question: What is the limit for accepting gifts from suppliers?
cases.expect: worth up to 50 euros

cases.question: How long is robot telemetry kept?
cases.expect: kept for 13 months, then deleted automatically

cases.question: How long are backups kept?
cases.expect: Backups are encrypted and kept for 35 days

cases.question: How long are invoices and accounting records retained?
cases.expect: kept for ten years, as required by tax law

cases.question: How quickly are customer deletion requests completed?
cases.expect: completed within 30 days

cases.question: When must new hires complete the security awareness course?
cases.expect: security awareness course within your first 14 days

cases.question: When are a new hire's accounts activated?
cases.expect: Your accounts are activated at 09:00 on your first day

cases.question: How many unused vacation days roll over into the next year?
cases.expect: Up to 5 unused days roll over

cases.question: What is the per diem in high-cost cities?
cases.expect: or 60 euros in the high-cost cities

cases.question: For how long is production access granted?
cases.expect: at most 12 hours at a time

cases.question: What cutting heights does the M1 support?
cases.expect: between 20 and 60 mm

cases.question: With the self-emptying base, where does the dirt go?
cases.expect: into a sealed bag

cases.question: The light on my vacuum's base turned red. What now?
cases.expect: pull out any clog with the hook tool

cases.question: Can I stop the base making a racket at night?
cases.expect: set quiet hours in the app

cases.question: Can I tip out the bag and put it back in?
cases.expect: Bags cannot be emptied and reused

cases.question: I'm a freelancer. Do I get paid holidays?
cases.expect: Contractors don't accrue paid vacation

cases.question: Can a freelancer hand their work over to someone else?
cases.expect: passed on to a subcontractor

cases.question: As a contractor, how do I get my train ticket paid back?
cases.expect: claimed on the next invoice, not in Spendly

cases.question: I want a new monitor for 300 euros. Who signs that off?
cases.expect: your manager approves the purchase

cases.question: Can I break one big order into a few small ones to avoid extra sign-off?
cases.expect: Splitting a purchase into smaller orders

cases.question: Can I sign up for a free online tool with my work email?
cases.expect: including free tools that need a company account

cases.question: A supplier sent me a bottle of wine worth 80 euros. Is that a problem?
cases.expect: Anything above that must be declared to Finance

cases.question: How long do you keep my CV if I don't get the job?
cases.expect: deleted six months after the hiring decision

cases.question: Will you restore a backup to get back personal data that was deleted?
cases.expect: backups are never restored just to recover deleted personal data

cases.question: The lawyers told us to keep everything about a dispute. Does the normal schedule still apply?
cases.expect: deletion of the affected data is suspended until the hold is lifted

cases.question: What do I do with old printouts that are confidential?
cases.expect: go in the locked shredding bins

cases.question: When will I get my first paycheck?
cases.expect: If your bank details are in by the 15th

cases.question: Who can I ask the silly questions when I start?
cases.expect: paired with a buddy from another team

cases.question: How often will I meet my manager in my first three months?
cases.expect: structured check-ins at 30, 60 and 90 days

cases.question: Can the mower stay in the garden over winter?
cases.expect: store the mower indoors, fully charged

cases.question: Can I read work email on my own phone?
cases.expect: Personal phones may be used for email and chat only after installing the device-management profile

cases.question: Do I need to warn anyone before taking three weeks off?
cases.expect: Vacation requests longer than 10 consecutive working days need four weeks

cases.question: How often do customers hear from us during a major outage?
cases.expect: updates the status page every 30 minutes during a SEV1

cases.question: I lost the company credit card. What should I do?
cases.expect: must be blocked in the Spendly app immediately
